hero.title: Engineering of technical equipment and systems
hero.description: We design and size the technical and digital equipment required for your agro-systemic projects, from mechanization to cold chain, including irrigation and connectivity systems.

distinction.title: Our role:
distinction.text: XP-NOVA provides engineering, studies and technical specifications. The supply of equipment, installation works and operation are entrusted to specialized service providers selected according to your needs.

domains.title: 8 domains for complete projects
domains.intro: From production equipment to storage systems, including energy and connectivity, we cover all the technical needs of agro-systemic projects.

mechanization.title: Mechanization
mechanization.description: Tractors, soil preparation equipment, planting and harvesting adapted to African contexts.

irrigation.title: Irrigation and water
irrigation.description: Irrigation systems (drip, sprinkler, gravity), pumping, water treatment and storage.

processing.title: Processing and plants
processing.description: Agri-food processing units, production lines, packaging equipment.

storage.title: Storage, preservation and cold
storage.description: Warehouses, silos, cold rooms, cold chain, product preservation systems.

energy.title: Energy and utilities
energy.description: Solar energy, generators, electrical networks, industrial utilities.

handling.title: Handling and logistics
handling.description: Conveyors, forklifts, handling systems, internal logistics equipment.

digital.title: Digital equipment
digital.description: Management software, sensors and IoT, connectivity, monitoring and control systems.

services.title: 10 services for informed choices
services.intro: We support your projects from needs analysis to equipment reception, including specification design and solution selection.

needs_analysis.title: Needs analysis
needs_analysis.description: Diagnosis of technical needs, audit of existing systems and definition of objectives.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Study of alternative solutions, technico-economic comparison and reasoned recommendation.

architecture.title: Technical architecture
architecture.description: Design of system architecture, functional diagrams and data flows.

sizing.title: Sizing
sizing.description: Calculation of required capacities: flow rates, powers and storage capacities.

specifications.title: Specifications
specifications.description: Drafting of technical specifications for your calls for tenders.

offer_analysis.title: Offer analysis
offer_analysis.description: Compliance verification and technico-economic analysis of received offers.

testing.title: Testing
testing.description: Design of test protocols to verify equipment compliance.

performance.title: Performance verification
performance.description: On-site performance tests and validation of capacities in real conditions.

handover.title: Reception assistance
handover.description: Final verification, team training and transfer documentation.

cta.title: Does your project need technical expertise?
cta.subtitle: Our engineers support you in the design and sizing of equipment and technical systems adapted to your context.
